   164 |     /// @notice check that funds haven't gone missing during this function call
   165 |     modifier balancedBooks() {
   166 |         _;
   167 |         // using >= not == in case anyone sends tokens direct to contract
   168 |         require(
   169 |             erc20.balanceOf(address(this)) >=
   170 |                 totalDeposits + marketBalance + totalMarketPots,
   171 |             "Books are unbalanced!"
   172 |         );
   173 |     }
   174 | 
   175 |     /*╔═════════════════════════════════╗
   176 |       ║       GOVERNANCE - OWNER        ║

453 |     /// @dev not strictly required but prevents markets being shortchanged due to rounding issues
   454 |     function topupMarketBalance(uint256 _amount)
   455 |         external
   456 |         override
   457 |         balancedBooks
   458 |     {
   459 |         erc20.safeTransferFrom(msgSender(), address(this), _amount);
   460 |         marketBalanceTopup += _amount;
   461 |         marketBalance += _amount;
   462 |     }
